-- SEND MESSAGE FUNCTION
local function send(msg)
	pcall(function()
		if TextChatService.ChatInputBarConfiguration and TextChatService.ChatInputBarConfiguration.TargetTextChannel then
			TextChatService.ChatInputBarConfiguration.TargetTextChannel:SendAsync(msg)
		else
			local legacyEvents = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents", true)
			if legacyEvents then
				local sayMessage = legacyEvents:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
				if sayMessage then
					sayMessage:FireServer(msg, "All")
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

		tween.Completed:Wait()
		MainFrame.Visible = false

-- SPAM SYSTEM (CHARACTER LIMIT: 160)

local enabled = false

start.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local target = nameBox.Text
	local delay = tonumber(delayBox.Text) or 2
	local style = lineBox.Text ~= "" and lineBox.Text or "@"

	if target == "" then return end

	enabled = false
	task.wait(0.1)
	enabled = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while enabled do
			for _, msg in pairs(replies) do
				if not enabled then break end

				local fixedPrefix = "⛩️SCRIPT BY NOVA DADDY💀"
				local taggedTarget = "[" .. target .. "]"

				local baseText = fixedPrefix .. " " .. taggedTarget .. " " .. msg
				local totalLength = 180

				local remaining = totalLength - string.len(baseText)
				if remaining < 1 then
					remaining = 1
				end

				local line = string.rep(style, remaining)
				local finalMsg = fixedPrefix .. " " .. line .. " " .. taggedTarget .. " " .. msg

				send(finalMsg)
				task.wait(delay)
			end
		end
	end)
end)

stop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

end)
